source: City of Brussels Grand Place building snapshot
method: Manual pilot schema. Values marked proxy are extracted from source history, not inferred from imagery.

annotation_protocol.register: Use an official construction-year field; this source snapshot does not provide one.
annotation_protocol.facade: Record the source-described style separately from a future image-based style label.
annotation_protocol.structure: Treat a documented reconstruction date as a proxy only until historical imagery is reviewed.
annotation_protocol.confidence: Do not assign a final confidence score until image epochs, licensing and annotation review are complete.

records.selection_reason: Stone facade from 1641 followed by reconstruction in 1697–1704.

register.note: Brussels architectural heritage inventory entry 31123 lists reconstruction in 1697; the city dataset gives the broader range 1697–1704. This is an official reconstruction-date proxy, not a structured original-construction year; human review still required.

facade.note: Style is described by the public source; visual dating is pending.

structure.note: Reconstruction date from the public history text; not an aerial-image inference.

image_evidence.observation: Source record identifies a facade detail of Maison Le Cornet, Grand-Place 6; no change label assigned.

records.next_step: Use the permitted 1942 facade detail as visual evidence and record observed changes with a reviewer.
